about: Benchmark tasks for benchmark.py (#67). Each runs read-only in a throwaway copy of the project, with the project's CLAUDE.md, skills, agents and hooks loaded. `check` is the quality guard: every `all` pattern must match the answer, no `none` pattern may, and every named agent must have run. `samples` hold a good answer and a deliberately broken one, so selfcheck can prove the check can fail. `targets` name the lever:target pairs a task exercises, which is how optimize.py picks the tasks that can measure a change.

tasks.prompt: List every lever id in .claude/skills/token-optimizer/references/spend-levers.md (the ids in its ### headings), in the order they appear, one per line, and nothing else. Do not edit any file.

samples.pass:
idle-rebuild
cache-ttl-main
cache-ttl-subagent
mid-session-switch
always-loaded-edits
long-context
standing-context
tool-output-size
bash-filter
read-guard
model-per-agent
effort-level
subagent-fanout
samples.fail:
idle-rebuild
cache-ttl-main
cache-ttl-subagent
mid-session-switch
always-loaded-edits
long-context
standing-context
tool-output-size
bash-filter
model-per-agent
effort-level
subagent-fanout

tasks.prompt: Which hook script in .claude/hooks caps the output of Bash commands, and at how many characters? Answer in one line. Do not edit any file.

samples.pass: post_bash_filter.py caps Bash output at 12,000 characters (MAX_CHARS).

tasks.prompt: Delegate this to the python-developer agent and do not answer it yourself. Ask it to read .claude/skills/token-optimizer/scripts/usage.py and report the value of REBUILD_MIN_TOKENS and the two report keys that cache_profile() returns. Nothing may be edited. Reply with the agent's answer.

samples.pass: REBUILD_MIN_TOKENS is 20_000, and cache_profile() returns cache_by_session and top_rebuilds.
samples.fail: REBUILD_MIN_TOKENS is 10_000, and cache_profile() returns by_model and by_session.
